scope: Read-only pre-pilot review of actual own/public projection and bounded legal hidden-world sampler. No teacher scores/labels, no NN scoring or training; not C3 acceptance.
focus: Projection must exclude original hidden hands/RNG/next actual action/future outcomes; every returned field and nested field must be genuinely own/public.

Sampler input is only VisibleRoot; same visible input and seed must give same worlds even if original hidden source changes. Preserve own hand, counts, full legal history and known exchange; never use source truth on rejection.
Uniform shuffle allocations conditional on visible constraints; no inability-to-beat inference from pass. Known owner assignments and duplicate-card accounting must be correct.
Check repeated model331 input equality, bounded rejection and malformed/extra fields; use synthetic or actual existing temporary engine states only, no model inference.

Review representation-gap flags against actual317+14 encoder. Flags are a conservative initial filter, not a claim that current encoding is a sufficient statistic. Identify any concrete missing necessary constraint, or overflag that would unnecessarily exclude legal roots; no outcome-based eligibility tuning.
Reuse previously closed root-history/exchange checks; do not re-run H/whole source/baseline.
requiredOutput: Complete JSON role/reviewId/requestSHA256, findings with concrete positive and negative probes and limits. Decision only APPROVE_WORLD_SAMPLER_FOR_PILOT or CHANGES_REQUIRED. Save /private/tmp/C3-world-{role}-review-001.json. This cannot approve teacher quality, training, formal eval or C3overall.
boundary: Read-only repository; /private/tmp reports/probes allowed. No actual NN/MLP forward, training, production teacher labels or real ledger mutation.
